shots.why: Masons at work on a rat-trap bond wall: honest B-roll for the opening statement naming the technique.
Wide view of the mason team preparing mortar on a rat-trap bond wall: B-roll for the general claim, which the camera cannot show exactly.
Close-up of bricks standing on edge in a row: shows the second half, bricks placed on their edge.

blank.should_show: Graphic or AI shot of conventional brickwork with bricks laid flat, ready to contrast with the on-edge bricks that follow.
blank.why_no_footage: No candidate shows conventional flat-laid brickwork.

shots.why: High diagonal angle looks into the row of hollow cavities formed inside the brick-on-edge wall.

blank.should_show: Graphic: brick count of a conventional wall against a rat-trap bond wall, about 25 percent fewer bricks, leading to lower material cost.
blank.why_no_footage: A percentage and a cost claim; the only candidate is a grade B wall poster with a defect, not the saving itself.

blank.should_show: Graphic or AI shot: cross-section of the cavity wall with outside heat stopped by the air gap and a cooler room inside.
blank.why_no_footage: Heat flow and indoor comfort cannot be seen; candidates show only building exteriors.

shots.why: Close-up of individual red clay bricks, their texture and firing marks: suits a general statement about brick quality.

blank.should_show: Graphic: brick strength grade rising in step with building height (number of storeys).
blank.why_no_footage: No candidates; an abstract strength rule.

shots.why: Mason places a brick on edge onto the mortar bed and aligns it by hand.
Header and stretcher bricks go down along the course, the alternating pattern closing a cavity inside the wall.
Three completed courses at a corner show the finished pattern and the cavities on top; the laying itself is in the shot before.

blank.should_show: AI shot or graphic: finished rat-trap bond wall being wetted with water, with a seven-day counter.

shots.why: Finished two-storey rat-trap bond building facade: closing B-roll for the general statement.
Slow reveal of another completed two-storey brick building: calm closing image.
